# Lisbon 5-Day Slow-Travel Plan

A relaxed Lisbon itinerary for **2 adults** from **2026-09-14 to 2026-09-18**, built around **museums, scenic walks, and local food**.
Budget target is **$2,400 total excluding flights**, with a central stay and easy transit access.

## Trip Plan by Day

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Riverside First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in to a **central private room** in Baixa/Chiado/Príncipe Real, then take an easy orientation walk through **Rossio, Rua Augusta, and Praça do Comércio**.
- Afternoon: Visit **MUDE** or the **Lisbon Story Centre** if you want a light first museum stop; keep the pace flexible with café breaks.
- Food: Start with a simple local meal like **bifana, codfish, or petiscos** in Chiado.
- Action: [Button: Transit area] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/areas/baixa-chiado

### Day 2: Alfama, Fado, and Tile Heritage
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Explore **Alfama** on foot, including **Sé Cathedral** and viewpoints around **Miradouro de Santa Luzia**.
- Afternoon: Visit the **National Tile Museum** for a strong cultural stop, then rest before dinner.
- Food: Book a relaxed **fado dinner** or try grilled fish and vinho verde in Alfama.
- Action: [Button: Tile Museum] https://museudoazulejo.gov.pt/

### Day 3: Belém Museums and Riverside Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Take transit to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and a short riverside walk.
- Afternoon: Choose one museum: **MAAT** for contemporary art/architecture or the **Coach Museum** for a classic collection.
- Food: Have a **pastel de nata** stop at Belém and a seafood lunch nearby.
- Action: [Button: Belém area] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/areas/belem

### Day 4: Príncipe Real, Bairro Alto, and Miradouros
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Slow start with cafés and shops in **Príncipe Real**, then browse the **Botanical Garden** if you want a calm green space.
- Afternoon: Walk through **Bairro Alto** and pause at **Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara** for city views.
- Food: Try a modern tascas lunch, then keep dinner casual with shared plates or seafood rice.
- Action: [Button: Viewpoint map] https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/miradouro-sao-pedro-de-alcantara

### Day 5: Parque das Nações or Final Museum Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: If you want something modern and easy, spend the morning in **Parque das Nações** with a waterfront stroll.
- Afternoon: Use the last hours for a final museum or souvenir stop, then pack and enjoy a last relaxed meal.
- Food: End with a polished lunch or dinner in the city center before departure.
- Action: [Button: Plan transit] https://www.carris.pt/en/

## Budget Plan for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Central private room stay | **$1,000–$1,300** | 4 nights in a good transit area |
| Food and drinks | **$650–$850** | Mix of cafés, lunches, and 1–2 nicer dinners |
| Local transit | **$60–$100** | Metro, tram, bus, and occasional taxi |
| Museums and entry fees | **$140–$220** | 3–5 paid attractions total |
| Snacks, coffee, extras | **$120–$180** | Pastéis, wine, small splurges |
| Buffer | **$100–$200** | For price changes or upgrades |

### Budget Fit
- A comfortable target is **$2,000–$2,300**, which leaves room for a nicer room or a couple of upgraded meals.
- Staying in **Baixa, Chiado, or Príncipe Real** should keep transit simple while staying walkable.
- To stay near budget, prioritize **1 major museum per day max** and use transit instead of taxis.

## Packing for Mild Lisbon Autumn

### Clothing
- Light jacket or trench coat
- 4–5 tops
- 2–3 bottoms
- Comfortable walking shoes with grip
- One smarter outfit for dinner or fado
- Compact umbrella or packable rain shell

### Essentials
- Passport, cards, travel insurance details
- Phone charger and portable battery
- Reusable water bottle
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Any prescription meds

### Useful Extras
- Light scarf for breezy evenings
- Blister patches for long walking days
- Universal travel adapter if needed
- Small laundry kit for a 5-day trip

## Quick Actions

- Lisbon public transport: https://www.carris.pt/en/
- Portuguese museums and monuments: https://www.museusemonumentos.pt/
